plan.goal: Explore and critique the Shopify marketing-to-trial-to-admin funnel end to end, with primary focus on the free-trial onboarding flow and secondary coverage of pricing, resources, help, login, and sales-contact paths across desktop and mobile.
plan.summary: Begin on the marketing homepage and validate the main conversion entry points, especially the hero email/signup CTA and repeated trial calls to action. Then drive deeply through the multi-step free-trial form, including forward progress, skip behavior, and completion to the "Your store is ready!" state. After the core funnel, cover adjacent decision-support and recovery paths on pricing, help, resources, admin login, and sales pages, and finish by repeating the highest-value journey plus navigation/tap-target checks on mobile.
assumptions: The primary journey is marketing homepage or pricing/resources entry points into free-trial onboarding, ending in a ready-store/admin-like success state.

free-trial-form.html appears to be a scripted multi-step onboarding flow with intermediate questions, account creation fields, and a final success state even though only limited controls were exposed in prescan.
admin.html and sales.html likely use client-side success/error states because headings include success messages despite the prescan landing on the initial form views.
Some top-nav and footer links point to '#' placeholders, so exploration should prioritize real HTML destinations over dead-end links.
Mobile risk is elevated because multiple nav/footer links were flagged as undersized tap targets in prescan.
risk_hotspots: index.html hero email field + Start free trial button: validate whether email capture is required, optional, or ignored before navigation
index.html FAQ accordion buttons: confirm expand/collapse behavior and content visibility
free-trial-form.html multi-step onboarding: risk of hidden validation, skipped states, broken progression, and unclear persistence between steps
free-trial-form.html Skip all control: important recovery/shortcut path called out in page copy
free-trial-form.html Create your Shopify account step: validate required fields, inline errors, and transition to 'Your store is ready!'
admin.html login form: test required-field behavior, store URL formatting, and alternate social login buttons presence/state
sales.html contact form: prescan reports missing_input_label warnings, so inspect labeling, keyboard focus, and select controls carefully
pricing.html monthly/yearly toggle: verify that prices and plan messaging actually update
pricing.html plan CTAs and Contact sales path: ensure self-serve vs enterprise branching is clear
help-trial.html search input and on-page anchor navigation: validate discoverability and internal navigation behavior
Top navigation and footer links across marketing pages: many small tap targets suggest mobile usability issues

phases.title: Homepage conversion entry and content discovery
phases.objective: Validate the main marketing landing page as a starting point into the trial funnel and inspect the most visible conversion/support interactions.
key_checks: Use the hero email input and Start free trial submit button to see whether submission routes into onboarding and whether blank vs populated input changes behavior
Compare the top-nav Start free trial link with the hero CTA destination and consistency
Open at least the visible FAQ accordion items on the homepage and confirm expand/collapse usability
Check whether footer support links route correctly to help-trial.html and free-trial.html
Note whether free-trial.html is materially distinct from index.html or effectively duplicate content
exit_criteria: Primary homepage CTA path into free-trial-form.html is confirmed via at least one working entry point
At least two FAQ items are expanded and observed
Duplicate-or-distinct relationship between index.html and free-trial.html is established

phases.title: Deep free-trial onboarding walkthrough
phases.objective: Exercise the core onboarding funnel thoroughly, covering guided setup, skip behavior, validation, and completion.
key_checks: Progress through the 'What are you planning to sell?' step and observe selection requirements before Next
Advance through 'Where would you like to sell?' and 'Where is your business located?' states, confirming transitions and back/continuation behavior if available
Use 'Skip all' to test the alternate fast-path and verify where it rejoins the flow
At the 'Create your Shopify account' step, test empty submission, partially completed submission, and a valid completion path if possible
Confirm the final 'Your store is ready!' state appears and document any success CTA or destination offered afterward
exit_criteria: Both a normal progression path and Skip-all path have been attempted or their availability limits clearly established
At least one validation behavior is observed on account creation or earlier required steps
The final success state is reached or a blocker is documented with specific failing step/control

phases.title: Decision support and enterprise branching
phases.objective: Validate plan comparison and the branch from self-serve pricing into enterprise sales contact.
key_checks: Toggle Pay monthly vs Pay yearly and verify displayed pricing changes for Basic/Grow/Advanced plans
Inspect plan card CTAs, especially Start free trial for self-serve plans and Contact sales for Plus
Open at least one pricing FAQ item and compare messaging against homepage trial/pricing claims
Follow the Contact sales path into sales.html and complete the form with the available text/select fields
Test sales form required-field behavior, select menus, and success acknowledgement state
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle behavior is confirmed as functional or nonfunctional
Enterprise branch to sales.html is exercised
Sales form is submitted successfully or validation failure points are captured

phases.title: Help, resources, and recovery journeys
phases.objective: Assess whether support and educational pages help users recover from uncertainty and re-enter the trial funnel.
key_checks: On help-trial.html, use the on-page table-of-contents links to jump among sections and confirm anchors work
Try the help search input to determine whether it accepts interaction and whether results/navigation occur
Follow the 'sign up for a free trial' help link back into the onboarding path
On resources.html, inspect key resource cards, especially Shopify Help Center, and confirm whether they navigate internally or externally within the local clone
Use the resources page trial CTA and compare its destination/behavior with homepage and pricing CTAs
exit_criteria: At least one support-driven re-entry into the free-trial funnel is confirmed
Help page anchor navigation is verified
Resources page CTA behavior is compared with other trial entry points

phases.title: Admin login and mobile critical-path verification
phases.objective: Probe the login experience and repeat the most important funnel checks under mobile constraints.
key_checks: On admin.html, test blank and populated login attempts using store URL, email, and password fields
Inspect 'Forgot password?' and the Apple/Google/Facebook buttons for visible affordance and behavior
Repeat on mobile: top-nav access, homepage hero CTA, and at least the first onboarding step on free-trial-form.html
Repeat on mobile: pricing toggle and one plan CTA
Pay special attention to previously flagged small tap targets in nav/footer and any overlap, clipping, or hard-to-tap controls
exit_criteria: Admin login form behavior is characterized, including whether any success/error state appears
Critical trial entry and first onboarding interaction are completed on mobile
At least one concrete mobile tap-target or layout issue is confirmed or ruled out on the key pages

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 8 known HTML pages, with deepest interaction on free-trial-form.html, pricing.html, admin.html, help-trial.html, and sales.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the main visible controls on each key page: homepage/email CTA and FAQs, onboarding progression and Skip all, pricing monthly/yearly toggle and plan CTAs, help anchors/search, login fields/social buttons, and sales form fields/selects/submit.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the critical funnel on mobile for index.html -> free-trial-form.html first step, plus pricing toggle/CTA and a quick nav/footer tap-target audit on pages already flagged with small targets.

notes: Do not spend much time on '#' placeholder links unless they unexpectedly open menus or reveal content.
Because free-trial.html appears very similar to index.html in prescan, treat it as a confirmation page rather than a separate deep dive unless execution shows meaningful differences.
If scripted states are hidden until interaction, prioritize reaching them over broad clicking on low-value footer links.
